summary: Learn third-party due diligence and integrity screening with questionnaires, sanctions logic, ownership checks, and reporting templates. Enrol now.
lede: Third-party due diligence and integrity screening provides a risk-based way to assess vendors, suppliers, contractors, and other business partners before and throughout the relationship. This course shows how to structure intake, evaluate ownership and sanctions concerns, identify integrity red flags, and decide when a case requires escalation. You will build practical tools including vendor risk questionnaires, due diligence checklists, screening logic, remediation plans, and approval summaries. The training also covers AI-assisted screening triage, case-management workflows, and dashboard monitoring, with approaches suited to teams working with incomplete data, tight deadlines, and tools ranging from spreadsheets to basic GRC workflows.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who review vendors, suppliers, contractors, intermediaries, or service providers and need a more structured third-party due diligence and integrity screening process.
prerequisites: You need a laptop for workshop exercises and editable access to spreadsheets or document templates. If your organization uses a third-party risk platform or case-management tool, bring a sample workflow only if internal policy allows it. Participants do not need prior coding, but they should arrive ready to work with vendor records, screening results, and due diligence evidence.
